---
title: "`r params$title`"
subtitle: "Generated with ScaleCheck"
author: "`r if (nzchar(params$author)) params$author else 'ScaleCheck user'`"
date: "`r format(Sys.time(), '%d %B %Y, %H:%M')`"

params:
  data: NULL
  data_label: "Dataset"
  settings: NULL
  sections: !r c("desc", "cor", "rel", "pa", "ega", "hull", "cfa", "irt", "mono", "li")
  code: NULL
  title: "Psychometric Assumption Diagnostics Report"
  author: ""
  helpers: "R/scalecheck_helpers.R"
  css: "www/scalecheck.css"

output:
  html_document:
    theme: flatly
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    toc_depth: 3
    number_sections: true
    self_contained: true
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
options(warn = -1)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  error = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center",
  out.width = "100%"
)

library(psych)
library(EGAnet)
library(EFA.MRFA)
library(lavaan)
library(eRm)
library(mokken)
library(corrplot)

source(params$helpers, local = knitr::knit_global())

dat <- params$data
if (is.null(dat)) dat <- sc_example_data("Big Five Inventory (polytomous data)")[, 1:5]

s <- params$settings
if (is.null(s)) {
  s <- list(
    cor_method = "spearman", check_keys = FALSE, pa_iter = 50, pa_percent = 95, pa_corr = "Polychoric",
    ega_model = "glasso", ega_algo = "walktrap", hull_extr = "ULS", hull_index = "CAF",
    cfa_syntax = sc_cfa_syntax(names(dat)), cfa_estimator = "ULSMV", cfa_ordered = TRUE,
    irt_model = "auto", np_n = 1000, uva_cut = 0.25
  )
}

inc <- function(x) x %in% params$sections
safe <- function(expr) tryCatch(expr, error = function(e) structure(list(error = e), class = "sc_error"))
good <- function(x) !is.null(x) && !inherits(x, "sc_error")
show_html <- function(x) cat(x, "\n\n")
show_error <- function(x, what) if (inherits(x, "sc_error")) show_html(sc_error_html(what, x$error))

type <- sc_data_type(dat)
```

```{r css, results="asis"}
cat("<style>\n", paste(readLines(params$css, warn = FALSE), collapse = "\n"), "\n",
    "body { font-size: 15px; } .main-container { max-width: 1100px; }
     h1.title { color: #1f3b57; font-weight: 700; }
     h1, h2, h3 { color: #1f3b57; }
     .sc-summary-table td:first-child { font-weight: 600; }
     .sc-pill { display:inline-block; padding:2px 10px; border-radius:999px; font-size:0.8rem; font-weight:700; }
     .sc-pill-good { background:#ecf7f0; color:#2e8b57; } .sc-pill-warn { background:#fff8e1; color:#8a6000; }
     .sc-pill-bad { background:#fdecea; color:#c0392b; } .sc-pill-info { background:#eef4fb; color:#2f5d8a; }
     pre.sc-raw { font-size: 0.78rem; max-height: 400px; overflow: auto; }
     </style>")
```

```{r compute}
# ---- Run every requested analysis once, up front, so the executive
# ---- summary can report on all of them.
r <- list()
r$desc <- safe(sc_descriptives(dat))
if (inc("cor"))  r$cor  <- safe(sc_correlations(dat, s$cor_method))
if (inc("rel"))  r$rel  <- safe(sc_reliability(dat, isTRUE(s$check_keys)))
if (inc("pa"))   r$pa   <- safe(sc_parallel(dat, s$pa_iter, s$pa_percent, s$pa_corr))
if (inc("ega"))  r$ega  <- safe(sc_ega(dat, s$ega_model, s$ega_algo))
if (inc("hull")) r$hull <- safe(sc_hull(dat, s$hull_extr, s$hull_index))
if (inc("cfa"))  r$cfa  <- safe(sc_cfa(dat, s$cfa_syntax, s$cfa_estimator, isTRUE(s$cfa_ordered)))
if (inc("irt") || inc("mono")) r$irt <- safe(sc_irt(dat, s$irt_model))
if (inc("mono")) r$mono <- safe(sc_mono(dat))
if (inc("li")) {
  if (type == "binary") r$np <- safe(sc_np(dat, s$np_n))
  r$uva <- safe(sc_uva(dat, s$uva_cut))
  r$ca  <- safe(sc_ca(dat))
}
ok_or_null <- function(x) if (good(x)) x else NULL
```

# Executive summary

```{r summary, results="asis"}
pill <- function(level, text) sprintf("<span class='sc-pill sc-pill-%s'>%s</span>", level, text)
rows <- list()
add <- function(area, result, level, verdict) rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <<- c(area, result, pill(level, verdict))

d <- ok_or_null(r$desc)
if (!is.null(d)) {
  add("Data", sprintf("%d respondents, %d items, %d complete cases; %s", d$n, d$k, d$complete, sc_type_label(d$type)),
      if (length(d$constant)) "bad" else if (length(c(d$missing, d$sparse, d$skewed))) "warn" else "good",
      if (length(d$constant)) "Problem" else if (length(c(d$missing, d$sparse, d$skewed))) "Check" else "OK")
}
x <- ok_or_null(r$rel)
if (!is.null(x)) {
  main <- if (!is.na(x$omega)) x$omega else x$alpha
  add("Reliability", sprintf("&alpha; = %s, &omega; = %s, &omega;<sub>h</sub> = %s", sc_fmt(x$alpha), sc_fmt(x$omega), sc_fmt(x$omega_h)),
      reliability_level(main), reliability_label(main))
}
dims <- c(PA = if (good(r$pa)) r$pa$pa$N_factors_percentiles, EGA = if (good(r$ega)) r$ega$n_dim, Hull = if (good(r$hull)) r$hull$n_factors)
if (length(dims)) {
  agree <- length(unique(dims)) == 1
  add("Dimensionality", paste0(names(dims), ": ", dims, collapse = " · "),
      if (agree && dims[1] == 1) "good" else if (agree) "warn" else "warn",
      if (agree && dims[1] == 1) "Unidimensional" else if (agree) paste(dims[1], "dimensions") else "Methods disagree")
}
x <- ok_or_null(r$cfa)
if (!is.null(x)) {
  fm <- x$fm
  g <- isTRUE(fm$cfi >= .95 && fm$tli >= .95 && fm$rmsea <= .06 && fm$srmr <= .08)
  a <- isTRUE(fm$cfi >= .90 && fm$tli >= .90 && fm$rmsea <= .10)
  add("CFA fit", sprintf("CFI = %s, TLI = %s, RMSEA = %s, SRMR = %s", sc_fmt(fm$cfi, 3), sc_fmt(fm$tli, 3), sc_fmt(fm$rmsea, 3), sc_fmt(fm$srmr, 3)),
      if (g) "good" else if (a) "warn" else "bad", if (g) "Good" else if (a) "Acceptable" else "Poor")
}
x <- ok_or_null(r$irt)
if (!is.null(x) && inc("irt") && !is.null(x$fit)) {
  n_under <- sum(x$fit$Flag == "Underfit (noisy)")
  add("Rasch item fit", sprintf("%s; %d underfitting, %d disordered; separation reliability %s", x$model, n_under, length(x$disordered), sc_fmt(x$sep_rel)),
      if (n_under + length(x$disordered) == 0) "good" else if (n_under <= 2) "warn" else "bad",
      if (n_under + length(x$disordered) == 0) "OK" else "Check items")
}
x <- ok_or_null(r$mono)
if (!is.null(x)) {
  ser <- sum(x$table$crit > 80)
  add("Monotonicity", sprintf("Scale H = %s; %d item(s) with serious violations", sc_fmt(x$H), ser),
      if (ser > 0 || isTRUE(x$H < .30)) "bad" else if (any(x$table$crit > 40)) "warn" else "good",
      if (ser > 0) "Violated" else if (isTRUE(x$H < .30)) "Weak scale" else "Supported")
}
if (inc("li")) {
  n_li <- sum(
    good(r$np) && (nrow(r$np$sig_pairs) > 0 || isTRUE(r$np$t11_p < .05)),
    good(r$uva) && length(r$uva$redundant) > 0,
    good(r$ca) && length(r$ca$flagged) > 0
  )
  add("Local independence", sprintf("%d of %d test(s) flag local dependence", n_li, sum(good(r$np), good(r$uva), good(r$ca))),
      if (n_li == 0) "good" else if (n_li == 1) "warn" else "bad",
      if (n_li == 0) "Supported" else "Dependence found")
}

cat("<table class='table table-sm sc-table sc-summary-table'><thead><tr><th>Area</th><th>Result</th><th>Verdict</th></tr></thead><tbody>")
for (row in rows) cat(sprintf("<tr><td>%s</td><td>%s</td><td>%s</td></tr>", row[1], row[2], row[3]))
cat("</tbody></table>\n\n")
```

## Items worth reviewing

```{r review, results="asis"}
flags <- list()
flag <- function(items, reason) for (i in items) flags[[i]] <<- c(flags[[i]], reason)

if (good(r$desc)) { flag(r$desc$sparse, "sparse categories"); flag(r$desc$missing, "> 10% missing"); flag(r$desc$skewed, "strong skew") }
if (good(r$cor) && nrow(r$cor$neg)) flag(unique(c(r$cor$neg$Item_1, r$cor$neg$Item_2)), "negative correlations")
if (good(r$rel)) flag(r$rel$items$Item[r$rel$items$Flag != ""], "weak item-rest correlation")
if (good(r$ega)) flag(r$ega$membership$Item[is.na(r$ega$membership$Dimension)], "not assigned in EGA")
if (good(r$cfa)) flag(r$cfa$loadings$Item[r$cfa$loadings$Flag != ""], "weak/odd CFA loading")
if (good(r$irt) && inc("irt") && !is.null(r$irt$fit)) {
  flag(r$irt$fit$Item[r$irt$fit$Flag != ""], "Rasch misfit")
  flag(r$irt$disordered, "disordered thresholds")
}
if (good(r$mono)) {
  flag(r$mono$table$Item[r$mono$table$ItemH < .30], "ItemH < .30")
  flag(r$mono$table$Item[r$mono$table$crit > 80], "monotonicity violation")
}
if (good(r$uva) && length(r$uva$redundant)) flag(unique(c(names(r$uva$redundant), unlist(r$uva$redundant))), "redundant (UVA)")
if (good(r$ca)) flag(r$ca$flagged, "local dependence (CA)")
if (good(r$np) && nrow(r$np$sig_pairs)) flag(unique(c(r$np$sig_pairs$Item_1, r$np$sig_pairs$Item_2)), "local dependence (T1)")

if (!length(flags)) {
  show_html(sc_callout("good", "No item was flagged", "<p>No item was flagged by any of the analyses that were run.</p>"))
} else {
  tab <- data.frame(
    Item = names(flags),
    Times_flagged = vapply(flags, length, integer(1)),
    Reasons = vapply(flags, function(x) paste(unique(x), collapse = "; "), character(1)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  tab <- tab[order(-tab$Times_flagged), ]
  tab$Flag <- ifelse(tab$Times_flagged >= 3, "Flagged by 3+ checks", "")
  show_html(paste0(
    "<p>Items flagged by one or more analyses, sorted by how often they were flagged. Items flagged by several independent methods ",
    "are the strongest candidates for revision, recoding or removal. Always check their content before deciding.</p>",
    sc_table_html(tab, flag_col = "Flag")
  ))
}
```

# Dataset and settings

```{r dataset, results="asis"}
settings_tab <- data.frame(
  Setting = c("Dataset", "Items analysed", "Response format", "Correlation method", "Reverse-key check (alpha)",
              "Parallel Analysis", "EGA", "Hull method", "CFA estimator", "CFA items treated as", "Rasch model",
              "T1/T11 samples", "UVA wTO cut-off"),
  Value = c(
    params$data_label, paste(names(dat), collapse = ", "), sc_type_label(type), s$cor_method, s$check_keys,
    sprintf("%s random datasets, %sth percentile, %s correlations", s$pa_iter, s$pa_percent, s$pa_corr),
    sprintf("%s network, %s algorithm", s$ega_model, s$ega_algo),
    sprintf("%s extraction, %s index", s$hull_extr, s$hull_index),
    s$cfa_estimator, if (isTRUE(s$cfa_ordered)) "ordinal" else "continuous",
    if (s$irt_model == "auto") "automatic" else s$irt_model, s$np_n, s$uva_cut
  )
)
show_html(sc_table_html(settings_tab, flag_col = "none", caption = "Data and analysis settings"))
cat("\n\n<p><b>CFA model:</b></p>\n\n<pre>", htmltools::htmlEscape(s$cfa_syntax), "</pre>\n\n")
```

```{r descriptives, results="asis", eval=inc("desc")}
}
```

```{r reliability, results="asis", eval=inc("rel")}
cat("Cronbach's alpha assumes all items contribute equally (tau-equivalence). McDonald's omega lets loadings differ,",
    "and omega hierarchical shows how much of the total score reflects one general factor. The GLB is an optimistic reference value.",
    "Guidelines: < .60 poor, .60–.69 questionable, .70–.79 acceptable, .80–.89 good, ≥ .90 excellent.\n\n")
show_error(r$rel, "Reliability")
if (good(r$rel)) {
  show_html(sc_rel_tiles(r$rel))
  show_html(sc_interp_rel(r$rel))
  show_html(sc_table_html(r$rel$items, caption = "Corrected item-rest correlations and alpha if item dropped"))
}
```

`r if (inc("cfa")) "# Confirmatory Factor Analysis"`

```{r cfa, results="asis", eval=inc("cfa")}
cat(sprintf("The model below was estimated with lavaan using the **%s** estimator%s.\n\n",
            s$cfa_estimator, if (isTRUE(s$cfa_ordered)) ", with items treated as ordered categorical" else ""))
show_error(r$cfa, "The CFA model")
if (good(r$cfa)) {
  show_html(sc_cfa_tiles(r$cfa))
  show_html(sc_interp_cfa(r$cfa))
  cat("\n\n## Fit indices\n\n")
  show_html(sc_table_html(r$cfa$fit_table, flag_col = "none"))
  cat("\n\n## Standardized loadings\n\n")
  show_html(sc_table_html(r$cfa$loadings))
  if (nrow(r$cfa$factor_cor)) show_html(sc_table_html(r$cfa$factor_cor, caption = "Factor correlations"))
  if (!is.null(r$cfa$mi) && nrow(r$cfa$mi)) {
    cat("\n\n## Largest modification indices\n\n")
    cat("Residual covariances (`~~`) point to item pairs that share variance beyond the factor. Cross-loadings are shown as `=~`.\n\n")
    show_html(sc_table_html(r$cfa$mi, flag_col = "none"))
  }
}
```

`r if (inc("irt")) "# Rasch / Item Response Theory"`

```{r irt, results="asis", eval=inc("irt")}
cat("A Rasch-family model was estimated by conditional maximum likelihood (eRm). Respondents with fewer than two valid answers were removed,",
    "and responses were shifted so the lowest category is 0.\n\n")
show_error(r$irt, "The Rasch model")
if (good(r$irt)) {
  show_html(sc_interp_irt(r$irt))
  if (!is.null(r$irt$fit)) {
    cat("\n\n## Item fit\n\n")
    cat("Infit/outfit mean squares between 0.7 and 1.3 are acceptable. Values above 1.3 mean noisy items, and values below 0.7 mean overly predictable ones.\n\n")
    show_html(sc_table_html(r$irt$fit))
  }
  if (!is.null(r$irt$thresholds)) {
    cat("\n\n## Item locations and thresholds\n\n")
    th <- r$irt$thresholds
    th$Flag <- ifelse(th$Item %in% r$irt$disordered, "Disordered thresholds", "")
    show_html(sc_table_html(th))
  }
}
```

`r if (inc("mono")) "# Monotonicity"`

`r if (inc("mono")) "## Mokken monotonicity"`

```{r mono, results="asis", eval=inc("mono")}
cat("Monotonicity means the probability of endorsing an item never decreases as the latent trait increases. ItemH ≥ .30 is the minimum for a Mokken scale.",
    "Molenaar's crit values above 80 are serious violations.\n\n")
show_error(r$mono, "The monotonicity check")
if (good(r$mono)) {
  show_html(sc_interp_mono(r$mono))
  t <- r$mono$table
  t$Flag <- ifelse(t$crit > 40 | t$ItemH < .30, "Check", "")
  show_html(sc_table_html(t))
}
```

```{r mono-plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=max(4, ceiling(ncol(dat) / min(4, ceiling(sqrt(ncol(dat))))) * 2.6), eval=inc("mono") && good(r$mono)}
sc_plot_mono(r$mono)
```

`r if (inc("mono") && good(r$irt)) "## Item characteristic curves"`

```{r icc, fig.width=10, fig.height=sc_icc_height(ncol(dat), if (good(r$irt)) r$irt$model else "RSM") / 90, eval=inc("mono") && good(r$irt)}
sc_plot_icc(r$irt)
```

`r if (inc("mono") && good(r$irt)) "## Person–item map"`

```{r pimap, fig.width=9, fig.height=6, eval=inc("mono") && good(r$irt)}

```

`r if (inc("li")) "# Local independence"`

```{r li, results="asis", eval=inc("li")}
cat("Local independence means item responses are unrelated once the latent trait is taken into account.",
    "Violations inflate reliability, can distort dimensionality, and bias IRT estimates.\n\n")
show_html(sc_interp_li(ok_or_null(r$np), ok_or_null(r$uva), ok_or_null(r$ca)))

if (type != "binary") cat("*T1/T11 nonparametric Rasch tests were skipped because they require dichotomous items.*\n\n")
if (!is.null(r$np)) {
  cat("\n\n## Nonparametric Rasch tests (T1, T11)\n\n")
  show_error(r$np, "T1 / T11")
  if (good(r$np)) {
    cat(sprintf("T11 global test: p = %.3f.\n\n", r$np$t11_p))
    if (nrow(r$np$sig_pairs)) show_html(sc_table_html(transform(r$np$sig_pairs, Flag = "p < .05"), caption = "T1: item pairs with significant dependence"))
  }
}
cat("\n\n## Unique Variable Analysis\n\n")
show_error(r$uva, "UVA")
if (good(r$uva) && length(r$uva$redundant)) {
  show_html(sc_table_html(data.frame(
    Target_item = names(r$uva$redundant),
    Redundant_with = vapply(r$uva$redundant, paste, character(1), collapse = ", "),
    Flag = "Redundant"
  )))
} else if (good(r$uva)) cat("No redundant item pairs at wTO >", s$uva_cut, ".\n\n")
cat("\n\n## Mokken conditional association\n\n")
show_error(r$ca, "Conditional association")
if (good(r$ca)) {
  if (length(r$ca$flagged)) cat("Items flagged as locally dependent:", paste0("**", r$ca$flagged, "**", collapse = ", "), "\n\n")
  else cat("No item was flagged as locally dependent.\n\n")
}
```

# General conclusions

```{r conclusions, results="asis"}
cat("Psychometric quality comes from the **convergence of evidence**. No single statistic proves that an instrument is reliable, unidimensional or valid.",
    "The summary table at the top brings together what was run here. Items flagged by several independent methods deserve the closest look.\n\n")
cat("The thresholds used in this report are practical heuristics, not strict decision rules. Interpret them alongside the theory behind the construct,",
    "the content of the items, the sample and the intended use of the scores.\n\n")
```
